scope: Human-reviewed static contracts; anchor checks prove traceability only. No production changes or dynamic memory/parallel qualification.

contracts.statement: The configuration entry point validates input and copies RuntimeConfig values into process globals before invoking GeneratorAdaptive through synthetic legacy arguments.
contracts.limits: Re-entrant independent configurations are not established; extracting a context is stage 6 work.

contracts.statement: In serial Execute, Geometry and Model are stack objects; Model borrows geometry_ and its destructor deletes pointers stored in meshes_.
contracts.limits: Model copy safety and all alternative MPI/model-loader lifetime routes are not qualified.

contracts.statement: Geometry owns points, vectors, curves and patches with unique_ptr containers; raw InsertCurve/InsertPatch APIs adopt the argument.
contracts.limits: Aliased adoption or observers surviving Geometry destruction remain caller obligations.

contracts.topic: Physical mesh ownership and node copy
contracts.statement: MeshAdaptive owns SubMesh objects, each SubMesh owns nodes/elements; SetNoh copies *noh while SetElement adopts its pointer.
contracts.limits: The grouped header comment says raw-pointer ownership, contradicting SetNoh; caller ownership and copied adjacency need explicit contracts before repair.

evidence.anchor: Compatibility API: takes ownership of raw pointers.

contracts.statement: TriangleAdaptive borrows three NodeAdaptive pointers, registers itself in each adjacency and caches normal, area and angles. NodeAdaptive adjacency is an observer list.
contracts.limits: Default node copies also copy observer lists; removal, coordinate mutation, cache refresh and destruction order require lifecycle qualification.

contracts.statement: Patch stores a non-owning current SubMesh pointer and SubMesh stores a non-owning Patch pointer. PatchCoons borrows Geometry-owned curves.
contracts.limits: Replacing a submesh invalidates old observers; rollback must rebind every patch before the next adaptation.

contracts.statement: Geometry reuses matching four-control Bezier curves in direct or reverse direction. CurveAdaptive does not delete its sampled points; its point and patch lists are observers.
contracts.limits: Legacy proximity-based matching and sample ownership are not replaced by this inventory; snapshot/restore currently deletes and recreates sample nodes explicitly.

contracts.statement: Each patch incidence maps local t to canonical t or 1-t; control construction, adaptive boundary traversal and physical edge intervals consume that direction.
contracts.limits: Canonical curve storage does not introduce welding or a new boundary-generation technique.

contracts.statement: Adapter creates old 2D faces from each physical triangle’s stored UV, seeds current boundary vertices from canonical samples, executes CRABMesh, maps new interior vertices through PatchCoons::Parameterize and preserves UV on output triangles.
contracts.limits: Parametric vertices and physical nodes have distinct identity/units and must not be merged into a universal mesh.

contracts.statement: Default AdvancingFront allocates Boundary and Quadtree; its destructor deletes the quadtree; Quadtree deletes a non-null boundary and root.
contracts.limits: External-pointer constructors/setters imply adoption and special mate-root sharing; no universal observer-only or leak-free interpretation is justified.

contracts.statement: Edge and Face destructors delete non-null endpoint pointers, although mesh vertices are shared. Boundary/front cleanup detaches endpoints before deleting these objects.
contracts.limits: This is a conditional destruction protocol, not consistent observer ownership; exceptional/fallback/partial teardown paths need stage 3 negative controls.

contracts.statement: Generator snapshots curve point id/XYZ, restores patch submesh observers, deletes unique sampled point pointers, then reconstructs shared samples by ID before retries and after rejection.
contracts.limits: Raw pointer stability is not preserved; error/history/budget state and every inner attempt require explicit transaction/observer contracts.

contracts.statement: Generator retains saved accepted and rejected meshes via unique_ptr; SaveMesh observes the candidate before later rollback. Adapter returns the selected attempt via release().
contracts.limits: Saving a rejected candidate does not accept it; holding more meshes changes retention/peak-memory behavior and is not permission to prune the scientific trace.

contracts.statement: CurvatureAnalytical evaluates surface derivatives after FindUV; CurvatureDiscrete uses physical-node triangle adjacency, areas and angles.
contracts.limits: Analytical and discrete curvatures are different quantities used for error/adaptation; consolidating their formulas would change the technique.

contracts.statement: Adapter and AdvancingFront both compute face quality statistics, while Generator computes physical mesh statistics. These measurements can refer to different stages and coordinate spaces.
contracts.limits: Shared aggregation is only a future candidate after domains, thresholds, degenerate handling and floating-point ordering are proved equivalent.

contracts.statement: Central definitions expose Eigen fixed-size aliases; PatchBezier evaluation and inverse mapping use matrix operations. CRABMesh also has root-finding numerical helpers.
contracts.limits: No alternative solver or Eigen deletion is authorized by this inventory; stage 5 requires analytic and aliasing/differential comparisons.

contracts.statement: Several patch/Bezier control setters assign point members without rebuilding coefficient matrices; curve setters differ in whether length is recomputed.
contracts.limits: This statically visible mutation contract is not evidence of a current serial CLI regression. Define immutability or explicit rebuild and test it before reuse.

evidence.anchor: void PatchBezier::SetPt00(const PointAdaptive point) { pt00_ = point; }

contracts.statement: CMake defines AP_MESH_HAS_OPENMP/AP_MESH_HAS_MPI, while production branches use USE_OPENMP/USE_MPI with false defaults.
contracts.limits: No bridge appears in indexed production files; external defines may alter this. Stage 4 must qualify effective preprocessing and routing, not merely successful linkage.

contracts.statement: Timer accumulates gettimeofday-based intervals; Data::time uses platform-dependent implementations.
contracts.limits: Current clock resolution/monotonicity and performance comparability are not qualified; no speedup claim follows from this inventory.

contracts.statement: AdvancingFront executes old-mesh quadtree generation, neighbor refinement, optional templates, geometric front with conditional topology fallback, then fill and improvement. Generator adapts shared curves before patch interiors and evaluates candidates before acceptance/rollback.
contracts.limits: This ordering is a preservation constraint, not a proposed replacement algorithm.

contracts.statement: Serial mesh export deduplicates submesh node incidences by logical global node ID; pointer equality or close XYZ is not the export identity. Local front IDs and physical IDs use different contexts.
contracts.limits: Boundary copies may share a logical ID across submeshes; conflicting coordinates for one ID are invalid. Proximity matching during input must not silently become export welding.

contracts.statement: PatchCoons(PatchCoons*) invokes only its Patch base copy path and leaves its curve vector default-constructed; the pointer-taking Bezier copy separately copies control/matrix/direction fields.
contracts.limits: These paths are not a qualified complete geometry clone; no current serial CLI failure is inferred. Copy/observer semantics need separate tests before reuse or ownership consolidation.
